name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the gouge and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the gouge stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the cut and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the cut stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the gash and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the gash stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the life-threatening gash and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: It's not easy and it takes some time, but with enough pressure the flow of blood from the life-threatening gash stops.

name: Clean the scratch
description: Use water to wash the scratch of dirt, debris, and bacteria.
success_msg: You clean the area where your scratch is.

name: Clean the large scratch
description: Use water to wash the large scratch of dirt, debris, and bacteria.
success_msg: You spend some time wiping the area down, making sure to pay attention to places where the skin broke.

name: Flush the gouge
description: Use water to flush out contaminants from your gouged skin.
success_msg: You thoroughly flush the gouge with water to remove any foreign contaminants.

name: Wash the cut
description: Use water to wash the cut of dirt, debris, and bacteria.
success_msg: You wipe down the area around the cut and take extra care to make sure the inside of it is clean.

name: Flush the gash
description: Use water to flush out contaminants from the open gash in your skin.
success_msg: You thoroughly flush the gash with water to remove any foreign contaminants.

name: Flush the life-threatening gash
description: Use water to thoroughly flush out every last trace of contamination from your sliced open limb.
success_msg: You spend quite a while flushing water through your sliced open skin, knowing that anything less than full flush of all contaminants will kill you from sepsis with a cut this major.

name: Bandage the scratch
description: Apply a bandage to your superficial scratch.
success_msg: You apply a bandage to your scratched skin.

name: Bandage the large scratch
description: Wrap a bandage around your large scratch.
success_msg: You wrap a bandage around your large scratch.

name: Bandage the gouge
description: Use a bandage to cover and protect your gouged skin.
success_msg: You wrap a bandage around your gouged skin.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your scratch.
success_msg: You remove the aging dressing from your scratch and apply a fresh one.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your large scratch.
success_msg: You remove the bloody dressing from your large scratch and wrap new one around it.

name: Bandage the cut
description: Use a bandage to cover and protect your cut open skin.
success_msg: You remove the blood-soaked dressing from your cut and wrap a fresh one around it.

name: Bandage the gash
description: Use a bandage to cover and protect your open gash so it can heal.
success_msg: You make sure the bandage is securely wrapped and that each part of the gash is covered.

name: Bandage the life-threatening gash
description: Use a bandage to wrap the sliced open limb.  The cut is large enough that you're going to end up with more of it covered than not just to make sure there aren't any gaps.
success_msg: You spend some time making sure the entire gash is covered and protected from contamination.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your cut
success_msg: You remove the blood-stained dressing from your cut and wrap fresh one around it.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your gash
success_msg: You remove the blood-soaked dressing from your gash and wrap fresh one around it.
